hero_image.prompt: Premium robotics textbook hero illustration of RoboRover in a clean indoor test arena viewing a camera image overlay. Show three clearly drawn bounding boxes around a blue supply crate, a yellow cone, and a red navigation beacon, with restrained technical labels for class names and confidence values. Include subtle image-coordinate arrows with x increasing rightward and y increasing downward. Use technically plausible rover hardware, realistic materials and lighting, professional editorial composition, high visual clarity, no decorative sci-fi elements, no clutter, and no large text blocks.
hero_image.caption: RoboRover’s camera system reports where an object is, what class it may belong to, and how strongly the detector supports the result.
hero_image.alt_text: A small mobile rover views an indoor arena while an annotated camera image shows colored bounding boxes around a crate, cone, and beacon with class labels and confidence scores.

inline_visuals.caption: An object-detection result combines location, category, and evidence strength.
inline_visuals.alt_text: A diagram of a camera image with a box around a crate and three callouts identifying its location, class, and confidence.
